table.name: TLGNR_MAINT_TYPE_TX
table.description: Language depending attributes for wagon maintenance types

column.name: MAINT_TYPE_CD
column.description: Part of PK Code of the reference data. E.g. G1.0 (unplanned maintenance), G4.0 (Revision), C (Cleaning) etc.

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK tlgnr_lang_bs. Code of the language in which TXT describes MAINT_TYPE_CD.

column.name: TXT
column.description: Translation of the description in the language LANG_CD.
